text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up 1: overnight we saw a spike of 503s on the onboarding ingest endpoint that impacted some new imports. Need a short customer-facing status, timeline, office hours, and a credit offer. Who can draft?
devops_bot: Alert: 503 spike 2026-03-22T04:12Z->04:40Z. Peak ~18% errors on /v1/ingest. Autoscaler fallback noted at 04:18Z.
jordan_se: Ill draft a concise outbound: brief incident summary, explicit no-data-loss line, timeline bullets, credit claim info, and office hours invite.

jordan_se: Draft below (please quick-edit):

Hi <customer>,

We experienced intermittent ingestion errors on March 22 that affected a portion of onboarding imports. Root cause: an autoscaler edge case that briefly directed some import traffic to a scaled-down pool, resulting in transient 503 responses. Mitigation: the autoscaler policy was reverted and targeted capacity added; error rates normalized by 04:40Z UTC.

Timeline:
- 04:12Z: spike detected
- 04:18Z: autoscaler fallback observed
- 04:25Z: capacity bump applied
- 04:40Z: metrics normalized

No customer data was lost. We will proactively re-ingest any failed imports and share a detailed RCA within 48 hours. Were offering a one-time credit for affected imports; credits issued within 7 business days after acceptance and are non-transferable.

If youd like live help, join office hours on March 23 14:00 PT  RSVP: https://go.redwood/office-hours

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success

lee_support: Affected tenant list uploaded to private doc (high-touch: Acme, BloomOps, NimbusAI). Lee will confirm contact emails.
sam_ce: Office hours hosts confirmed: sam_ce + ryan_infra + eng-oncall. Calendar invite + RSVP tracker shared.
lisa_legal: Legal OK on credit phrase; confirm SLA band in the RCA.
maria_cs: Action items: Jordan finalize and send to high-touch by EOD; Lee validate emails; Sam run office hours; Lisa legal sign-off by 15:00. Ill monitor renewal-risk replies and escalate.
